activity_summary: Arthur asked you to make the next lady tall, because Edith had let the hem down two fingers at Easter and his shins were out. You refused a new lady before dinner. You are Egeon this afternoon. Abel Garnish would not rename the doors.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Refused a new lady and named himself Egeon for the afternoon.

entities.name: Arthur Meeks
entities.context: Asked for a tall angry lady and agreed to stand where the plot put him.

entities.name: Abel Garnish
entities.context: Left the doors as they were and refused a third house.

entities.name: The Comedy of Errors
entities.context: Mentioned in The hem, and no new doors

facets.activity: Heard Arthur ask for a taller lady

quotes.speaker: arthur_meeks
quotes.text: Edith let the hem down two fingers at Easter, sir, and my shins are out in the wind again.

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: This afternoon is Egeon's, and Egeon is mine.

quotes.speaker: abel_garnish
quotes.text: I am not renaming a door because the yard is wider.
